ranked_facts.why: Bilateral inferior lens dislocation is a characteristic feature of Marfan syndrome and homocystinuria, which are part of the Genetic Disorder with Marfanoid Features branch, but it is less common or not typically associated with the other branches.

The ability to wrap one hand around the opposite wrist with thumb and fifth finger overlap is indicative of hypermobility and marfanoid habitus, features more commonly associated with the Genetic Disorder with Marfanoid Features branch.
